title: Team
description: The people clients will meet: a portrait, their role and years, their name and one line about them. Optionally, a card with how many more people there are and their trades.

lede.default: These are the people who price, plan and build your house. You’ll have their numbers from the first week.

default.name: Dan Okafor
default.fact: Ran Elm Row and Calder Road. Usually first on site and the last to lock up.

default.name: Marta Kowalska
default.fact: Reads every enquiry and rings back the next working day. Trained as an engineer in Kraków.

default.name: Sean Byrne
default.fact: Worked alongside Tom on other people’s jobs for years. Made the Gibson Square stair by hand, tread by tread.

moreText.default: All on our payroll, most of them for more than five years.
